An unmatched [ in image alt text is escaped so the image survives

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<img alt=\"[A;B)\" src=\"S\">");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
